frozen_geometry: P2-40 pivot X387, collection -3, transport 0, launch +15..+20; no change

p16_50_256_12_S.decision: compact reference / buy only if custom actuator test fails
p16_50_256_12_S.suffix: -S = internal end-of-stroke switches, two-wire control; not position feedback
p16_50_256_12_S.three_positions: -P is not required because AS5600 measures hinge angle; -S limits only physical stroke ends and external control stops at -3/0/+15..20
p16_50_256_12_S.note: hold/backdrive is not the launch reaction path; launch must seat on upper stop

fit0186_tr8x2.continuous_torque_status: NOT SPECIFIED: do not size from stall
fit0186_tr8x2.screening_band_basis: 20..30% of stall is a conservative design hypothesis, not a vendor rating; verify thermally at 12 V

tr8x2.self_locking: LIKELY only if effective thread friction coefficient exceeds tan(lead angle)=0.091; verify chosen nut, lubrication, backlash and vibration

mechanical_requirements: positive upper/lower stops; screw is not the launch load path

selected: FIT0186 + Tr8x2 after bench verification of continuous torque/temperature; preserve P16 clevis hole pattern as fallback

sensor.placement: inboard +Y trunnion face, opposite actuator; board plane normal to Y
sensor.magnet: D6x2.5 diametric magnet in non-magnetic shaft cap; 1.5 mm nominal airgap, adjustable 0.5..2.5 mm, concentricity target <=0.25 mm
sensor.levels: one verified bus pull-up voltage only; raw AS5600 may run at 5 V. Audit MPU6050/AS5600 breakout pull-ups and level-shift if either module is 3.3-V-only

driver.supply: 12 V regulated actuator rail from Parkside 15..21 V preferred; PWM limiting alone is not a regulated 12 V supply

stops.construction: replaceable indexed stop blocks at 1-deg holes, two M6 fasteners plus bearing shoulder; slots only for calibration, not shear retention
stops.load_path: launch reaction -> upper stop -> arch/yoke; lower stop supports selected collection endpoint; actuator unloaded at both endpoints

selector.mechanism: shaft cam + two opposed followers, lost-motion deadband and spring-centred fail-safe
selector.transition: between dwells both branches closed; adjustable cam phase follows the selected lower-stop index
selector.failure_state: broken link/spring or power loss -> both branches closed
selector.note: single rear mouth retained; cam does not singulate

singulator_reserve.concept: two-stage escapement with two fingers 70..75 mm apart and removable blind plate
singulator_reserve.actuation: reserve a low-force servo/solenoid interface for 5d; tilt cam selects route but cannot reliably count one ball

sequence: command both D5065 to zero and verify rpm below threshold
drive tilt using AS5600 closed-loop angle and timeout/current limit
seat endpoint on indexed stop or hold 0 deg by self-locking screw
only then enable collection or launch; launch additionally requires robot stationary

packaging.parkside_access: unchanged outboard extraction at Y sides; Ugreen removes vertically/rearward from centre bridge
packaging.measurement_gate: Parkside pack/adapter envelope remains unmeasured; require >=5 mm after physical measurement and connector bend radius

nominal_actuator_clearance.note: Y=-190 would overlap the new Y=-172 basket wall by 0.5 mm; dependent actuator brackets move to Y=-205 without changing X/Z leverage

locks_with_p52: actuator fixed clevis on X318 arch
Tr8 nut carriage and thrust-bearing housing
front basket/common-throat panels and feed-channel interface
remains_open: cable bend radii and strain-relief test

limitations: static analytic and nominal-envelope CAD only; no Gazebo
stall torque is never treated as continuous torque
no STL, firmware, robot-stack or electronics changes
